reasoning_traces.think:
The formal heartbeat operates as a monitoring layer that applies anytime-valid sequential testing via e-processes to detect deviations from expected Bernoulli event rates. It uses Ville’s inequality to ensure that false positives remain bounded under the null hypothesis. The kernel is grounded in game-theoretic statistics literature, particularly Ramdas–Grünwald–Vovk–Shafer 2023 and Waudby-Smith–Ramdas 2024, ensuring theoretical rigor. The projection module maps real-world control-plane events into abstract TLA+ states, maintaining semantic fidelity while enabling formal verification. Invariant checking then evaluates these projections against a set of composed and base invariants, detecting anomalies such as ambiguous exposures held beyond trusted resolution or budget overruns. This architecture decouples detection logic from production systems, ensuring no side effects while preserving full analytical integrity.
